ability.value: (Sans cannot be negated, always goes first, and cannot have his ability stolen) Sans has a 1/30 chance to be hit by an attack. Every time he ends his turn, attacks, or is attacked, the denominator of the hit chance is decreased by 3. Sans can attack 5 times per turn. Sans' attacks deal piecing damage and gives the target chaos counters. Chaos counters deal 1 piecing damage to the card they are on at the end of that card's turn
